_doc: Per-role LoRA adapter paths for LoRAHeterogeneousRouter.
Paths are relative to the repo root. Adapter files must exist
or the router logs the missing role and uses the base model.
When this file is missing OR every listed adapter is absent,
the router falls back to single-base-model with a log line —
LoRA training is future work. The mappings below are scaffold
placeholders; create the safetensors files at these paths to
activate per-role adapter routing on L4/A100 tiers.
